mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, date, qty, dict_inventory_status, virtual_trans_flow_id, batch_no, bill_date
mapper.select: WITH virtualTransFlowDetail AS ( select qty,virtual_trans_flow_id,virtual_inventory_detail_id from virtual_trans_flow_detail where id in ( SELECT max(id) FROM virtual_trans_flow_detail WHERE is_deleted = false and #{date} > trade_time group by virtual_trans_flow_id,virtual_inventory_detail_id) ),virtualInventory AS ( SELECT sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id ),virtualInventoryDetail AS ( SELECT sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(qty * (last_outstock_date - bill_date)) / count(0) AS days_difference FROM virtual_inventory_detail WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id ) select vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, now() as date, vid.dict_inventory_status, vid.virtual_trans_flow_id, vid.batch_no, vid.bill_date, vi.virtualUsableQty, vi.virtualFrozenQty, vtfd.qty, vitd.days_difference / virtualQty as avgInventoryAgeDays from virtual_inventory_detail vid left join virtualTransFlowDetail vtfd on vid.id = vtfd.virtual_inventory_detail_id left join virtualInventory vi on vid.sku_id = vi.sku_id and vid.warehouse_id = vi.warehouse_id and vid.virtual_warehouse_id = vi.virtual_warehouse_id left join virtualInventoryDetail vitd on vid.sku_id = vitd.sku_id and vid.warehouse_id = vitd.warehouse_id and vid.virtual_warehouse_id = vitd.virtual_warehouse_id where vid.is_deleted = false
